snippet.title: C64 Longplay: Boing (1989, E&J Software)
snippet.description:
Requested by Damoce kay. I'm pretty sure nobody has played all the way through this before. The gameplay is a bitch but deserves more than Zzap!64's 9% which is super harsh. The only thing that spoiled the game for me was it being too fast, so I played it through at half speed and sped it up to normal in the editing process. I also used a hundred save-states as it is absolutely impossible without that.

You'll notice that a lot of the platform layouts repeat themselves which initially led me to believe that it looped forever.
It changes on occasion and actually does have an ending, such as it is.

19:28 Not Johnson
19:38 And on it goes...
28:44 At this point I started using sprite collision off to get through temporary problems and hacked it to give infinite lives and ammo. Fuck it 
28:49 And on...
46:29 Ending and SID tunes

Spot the sprites:
Flashing balls that contain:
? (mystery item)
Skull and Crossbones (death)
New ball
Pistol (extra ammo)
Bomb (substitute for ammo if you run out of it. You can carry two of these)

Background:
The sun (at night!)
Diamond thing
Satellites
Flying snake
Swarm of flies
Dolphin
Shark
Whale
Worm
Birds
Loch Ness monster
XXX barrel
Hand in the water
Yellow submarine
Periscope
Yacht
Square-head with flashing eyes
SOS ring

Things that kill you:

Wasp
Snake

Evil Pacman
Pacman-esque ghost
Cauldron-esque ghost
